q20.raw:
```sql
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        COUNT(order_id) AS total_delivered,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_deliveries
    FROM 
        fact_order
    WHERE 
        order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY 
        seller_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(order_id) >= 100
),
late_delivery_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        (late_deliveries::DOUBLE / total_delivered) * 100 AS late_delivery_rate
    FROM 
        delivered_orders
)
SELECT 
    seller_id,
    late_delivery_rate
FROM 
    late_delivery_rates
ORDER BY 
    late_delivery_rate DESC
LIMIT 3
```

q22.raw:
```sql
WITH category_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        category, 
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_orders
    FROM 
        fact_order
    GROUP BY 
        category
),
max_category AS (
    SELECT 
        category
    FROM 
        category_orders
    ORDER BY 
        order_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((late_orders::DOUBLE / order_count) * 100, 2) AS late_delivery_rate_percent
FROM 
    category_orders
WHERE 
    category = (SELECT category FROM max_category)
```
